Maria / Blue Harbor team,

Attached is our current standard DPA (Redwood-Standard-DPA-v3.2.pdf) and an export of our current subprocessor roster (subprocessor_list_20260901.csv). Quick notes:
- Transfers: For customers in the EU, Redwood supports SCCs (we adopt the EU Commission standard contractual clauses) and can also execute a transfer addendum on top of our DPA if required. We do not rely on an adequacy decision for transfers by default.
- Subprocessors: CSV contains name, description of services, country of processing, and last attested date. We update this quarterly and will notify customers per the DPA notice cadence.
- Execution: We support DocuSign and AdobeSign. If you prefer DocuSign we can send an envelope; otherwise we can provide a PDF for internal review.

Next steps proposed:
1) Blue Harbor confirms preferred transfer mechanism (SCCs + DPA vs. any additional addendum).
2) If Docusign is ok, confirm signer name and email for execution.
3) If Blue Harbor requests redlines, please provide a consolidated redline PDF and we'll route to Legal.

I have not made any edits — this is the template we send to pilots.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
